decision: Two new mineral owners with bounded abiotic mechanisms. Named validation passed; independent native scientific reviews and final batch gates remain pending. This is a source handoff, not a scientific acceptance review or publication verdict.
selection: The original La and Nd descriptions are fully accessible and current IMA identities distinguish the species. Nd adds direct evolved-gas thermal observations on natural mixed-REE material; La adds an independently scoped synthetic solution-aging arm from a previously used source. Neither inherits constituent-element criticality or microbial causality.
